answer: Operator-Linked Terrace Vesting. Each agent wallet accrues rewards on a public terrace of graduated vesting tiers; withdrawing early forfeits the remainder to peers. Sybils are unprofitable because a cluster's fresh wallets must climb the same vine from tier zero while their operator-funded deposits sit locked. Anomalous coordination triggers a zenith freeze: the operator's entire vested balance, across all linked wallets, is slashed, transferring cost from disposable keys to the capital source.
